transcript: today, my friend Chelsea and I saw Kimberly Akimbo on Broadway, a musical about a teenager whose genetic disease causes her body to age much faster than normal. despite this premise, it's hilarious, joyful, and hopeful. this wasn't my first time seeing it, and I gotta say, it's such a rewatchable show. there's so much to appreciate about it, from the score and script to the phenomenal performances from the entire cast. please go see this. and with that, another playbill for my collection.
